target.what: Number of bottles of Zhenjiang Hengshun (Jiangsu Hengshun Vinegar-Industry Co., Ltd.) vinegar sold/exported to the United States in a full year, all bottled vinegar types combined, counted as physical bottles (not cases, not liters, not revenue)

kept.name: US share of Hengshun 2024 export revenue
kept.rationale: Hengshun's export segment is dominated by Asian diaspora markets (SE Asia, Japan, Hong Kong, North America). All-China HS2209 exports put the US at ~11% of vinegar export volume (p3); Hengshun's brand is stronger in SE Asia than in the US, so set near but not above the HS2209 US share, widened for b
kept.applies_when: Hengshun's US revenue share of exports is similar to the all-China HS2209 US share; transfers to a bottled-vinegar export flow.
kept.falsified_by: Annual-report or customs evidence that North America is a much larger or much smaller share of Hengshun exports.

kept.name: Vinegar share of Hengshun export revenue
kept.rationale: Vinegar is Hengshun's core product (~58% of condiment revenue per p96/p103), but the export segment also carries cooking wine, soy sauce and other condiments. Vinegar is the flagship export item, so set above its domestic revenue share.
kept.applies_when: The export mix is more vinegar-heavy than the domestic mix, as brand strength suggests.
kept.falsified_by: Export product-mix disclosure showing vinegar below half of export revenue.

kept.name: Average net fill per exported bottle
kept.rationale: US retail SKUs cluster at 500-580 ml (p45-p56, p57, p61, p64) and the export pack is 550 ml (p39). Weighted toward 500-550 ml commodity SKUs, with some 580 ml and a few 300 ml premium bottles, gives about 0.52 L.
kept.applies_when: Bottled (not bulk) vinegar dominates the US-bound flow, as the BOL descriptions indicate.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that a large share of US-bound volume is bulk/drum or very small bottles.

kept.name: Hengshun share of China HS2209 vinegar exports to the US
kept.rationale: Hengshun is China's largest vinegar producer and the best-known Zhenjiang vinegar brand, but China's US vinegar exports include many other producers and private-label brands. Set at a modest share of the value/volume flow, above a generic producer but well below dominance.
kept.applies_when: Hengshun's US-bound volume is a meaningful but minority slice of all Chinese vinegar entering the US.
kept.falsified_by: Import records showing Hengshun-named shipments account for a much larger or smaller fraction of Chinese vinegar imports.

kept.name: Growth factor from the 2020-2022 average annual US-bound HS2209 volume to 2024
kept.rationale: US Asian packaged-food retail sales grew ~10% in 2024 (p70) and unit sales ~7% (p71), while Hengshun's total export revenue grew 5.78% in 2024 (p94). A modest upward adjustment from the 2020-2022 average annual level to 2024 is consistent with these trends; tariffs and shipping costs could push it d
kept.applies_when: US demand for Chinese vinegar grew modestly between the 2020-2022 window and 2024.
kept.falsified_by: Customs data showing flat or declining China-to-US vinegar volumes in 2023-2024.

kept.name: Bottles per Hengshun US bill of lading
kept.rationale: Observed 2026 BOLs carry 1,150-1,575 cartons at 24 bottles per carton (p31, p33, p35, p40), i.e. 27,600-37,800 bottles per BOL. A 20-ft container (p86) holds roughly this range. Set the central value near the middle of the observed range.
kept.applies_when: 2024 BOLs had similar carton counts and 24-bottle packs as the 2026 records.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that 2024 shipments were much smaller (LCL) or used different pack sizes.

kept.name: Hengshun US-bound bills of lading per year in 2024
kept.rationale: ImportInfo records 169 BOLs over Feb 2022-Oct 2026 (~4.6 years), implying roughly 37 per year on average (p30). Some records may be non-vinegar or non-US; set the central value near the implied annual rate with a wide range.
kept.applies_when: The 2022-2026 BOL rate is representative of 2024 and most BOLs are US-bound vinegar.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that 2024 had far fewer or far more Hengshun US shipments than the multi-year average.

kept.name: Density of bottled vinegar
kept.rationale: Vinegar is essentially a dilute acetic-acid solution with density close to water. The observed BOLs corroborate this: 1,150 CTN x 24 x 550 ml = 15.18 kL against 24,955 kg (p31/p32) implies ~1.64 kg/L gross including glass and cartons; net vinegar density is near 1.0. Used to convert tonnes to liters
kept.applies_when: The vinegar-series tonnage in p98 is net product mass, so dividing by density gives net liters.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that p98 tonnage is gross shipping weight including packaging.

kept.name: Years spanned by the 2020-2022 cumulative HS2209 window
kept.rationale: p1 is a cumulative 2020-01-01..2022-12-31 total; dividing by the number of years in the window converts it to an annual average. Three calendar years is exact; the narrow range only reflects that the window may not be perfectly aligned to full years.
kept.applies_when: p1 covers exactly the three calendar years 2020-2022.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that the p1 window is shorter or longer than three years.
